FAMILY DENTIST IN WESTPORT, KANSAS CITY

At Cosmetic & Implant Dentistry, we proudly serve patients of all ages and oral health backgrounds. As a trusted dentist in Westport, we offer a wide range of services, including crowns, bridges, teeth whitening, and dental fillings in Kansas City, MO.

Whether you need a routine check-up or more urgent care like root canals or extractions, we’re here to help. Our friendly team is committed to making sure every patient feels comfortable and cared for in a warm, welcoming environment. We focus on personalized care, ensuring that both new and returning patients receive treatment that meets their unique needs and goals. Let us help you achieve a healthy, beautiful smile!

About Us
Convenient dental services

Cutting-Edge Technology

Our dental office has the most innovative equipment, technology, treatments, and solutions. We aim to continuously upgrade our services with the latest developments in the dental industry. From state-of-the-art X-rays to cleaning and whitening solutions, you can expect top-tier quality. We conduct treatments to make the smile brighter, straighter, and more natural. Whether you want to correct misaligned teeth, trauma, or discoloration, our team will provide the treatments you need to leave the office quickly and satisfied. Patients return to us for all their dental work because they can rely on our fast yet quality service and dedication to excellence.
Our Services

Full-Service Dental for Individuals and Families

No dental issue is too complex or challenging for our team to treat. From routine checkups to major procedures, you can depend on us to personalize your treatments and enhance your smile. Our services include

General Dentistry

Our general services include routine and bi-annual exams and oral health screenings to maintain the look and health of your teeth.

Full Mouth Restoration

If multiple dental issues are affecting your smile, full mouth restoration combines advanced treatments to rebuild your teeth's function, health, and appearance

Sedation

Dental anxiety shouldn't keep you from the care you need. We offer sedation options including nitrous oxide, oral sedation, and IV sedation so you can relax comfortably throughout your treatment.

Emergency Dentistry

When sudden oral trauma strikes, you can depend on us to restore your teeth quickly. We offer same-day appointments for dental emergencies.

Hygiene

We use the latest dental tools to remove plaque and tartar buildup from the hard-to-reach areas of the mouth.

Fillings

If you have a cavity, we can fill it. Our customized fillings fit the cavity's size and shape.

Mouth Guards

We develop mouth guards to protect the mouth and teeth from impacts and injuries. We can customize yours to fit your mouth precisely.

Dental Implants

If you're missing one or multiple teeth, our implants can restore your smile. They'll return your chewing, speaking, and smiling back to normal.

Crowns & Bridges

Our cosmetic crowns cover damaged or discolored teeth with a shiny white cap, while bridges fill missing gaps.

Veneers

Make your teeth right and beautiful with cosmetic veneers. Our veneers hide discoloration and staining so patients can smile confidently again.

Sleep Apnea

We provide nighttime mouth guards for patients with sleep apnea. Reduce snoring, improve breathing, and get better sleep with our solutions.

TMJ / TMD

TMJD is a painful and disruptive condition. Our mouth guards for TMJD carefully realign the jaw and prevent tooth grinding during sleep.

Clear Braces

Our clear braces offer patients the clearest, most comfortable solutions for straightening and aligning teeth.
